description: Replays the 'scale-and-replay' page: burst, scale the leaderboard to three members, then seek the group to the start and prove game.leaderboard converges to the same top 10.

tests.description: A burst drains, three members split the partitions, and a replay from the start of the log converges to an identical leaderboard

runShell.command: docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe leaderboard
for i in $(seq 1 30); do lag=$(docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe leaderboard </dev/null 2>/dev/null | awk '/^TOTAL-LAG/ {print $2}'); [ "$lag" = 0 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo lag=$lag
docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group seek leaderboard --to start
for i in $(seq 1 60); do lag=$(docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe leaderboard </dev/null 2>/dev/null | awk '/^TOTAL-LAG/ {print $2}'); [ "$lag" = 0 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo lag=$lag

for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/top > after.txt; diff -q before.txt after.txt >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; diff before.txt after.txt && echo "leaderboard identical after replay"
